headline: AbbVie (ABBV) Could Be 3% Undervalued Following Epcoritamab Trial Setback
summary: Genmab and AbbVie (ABBV) recently clarified that the U.S. portion of the Phase 3 EPCORE DLBCL-1 trial for epcoritamab did not meet its overall survival primary endpoint, raising fresh questions about the drug's long term commercial potential. See our latest analysis for AbbVie. Against this backdrop, AbbVie’s share price has had a strong run, with a 30-day share price return of 10.42% and a 90-day share price return of 30.52%. Its 1-year total shareholder return of 40.53% highlights momentum...
